name: vantagedash
description: Ask about your competitors' prices: where a competitor is cheaper than you, recent price changes, and whether your price checks worked. Reads your own VantageDash workspace and changes nothing.

interface.longDescription:
VantageDash keeps track of the prices your competitors charge for the products you sell. It is for shop owners who already use VantageDash. Connect your account and ask in plain words: which of my products is a competitor selling for less, what changed in my competitors' prices recently, how does one of my products compare, and did my last price checks work.

Prices are compared on the same footing: per item when the pack sizes differ, in your own currency, and with or without VAT as you set it. Only approved matches are counted, and you are told how many suggested matches wait for your review.

The plugin only reads your own workspace. It changes nothing, starts no price checks and never sees your billing, your team or your store connection. Competitor prices come from the public product pages of the competitors you chose to follow in VantageDash, read by VantageDash before you ask. ChatGPT does not visit any website through this plugin, and answers are as of your last price check.

You need a VantageDash account with at least one competitor.
capabilities: Find where a competitor is cheaper than you
Compare one of your products with its matches
Check when each competitor was last checked
defaultPrompt: Which of my products is a competitor selling for less?
What prices changed at my competitors in the last 30 days?
Did my competitor price checks work?

positive.description: Where a competitor is cheaper, across the workspace
positive.prompt: Which of my products is a competitor selling for less?
positive.expected_behavior: Says how many approved matches were compared and on how many a competitor is cheaper, then lists them with the largest gap first and both prices on the same footing.

positive.description: The same question for one competitor
positive.prompt: Where is Atlas Coffee Club cheaper than me?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers for Atlas Coffee Club only, and says so if it is cheaper on nothing.

positive.prompt: What prices changed at my competitors in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists changes on products matched to the user's own, largest first, and says how many more were on products not matched, which it can include if asked.

positive.prompt: How does my House Blend compare?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows House Blend at $18.99 against Bluebottle's Bella Donovan and says which side is cheaper and by how much.

positive.prompt: Did my competitor price checks work?
positive.expected_behavior: For each competitor, says when it was last checked and the result in plain words, with no technical error text. Bluebottle is marked as not checked automatically.

negative.description: General shopping about products the user does not sell: no tool should be used, and the answer should not draw on the plugin.
negative.prompt: What is the cheapest coffee grinder on Amazon?

negative.description: A request to change something: the plugin only reads, so no tool can do this and the answer should say it cannot be done here.
negative.prompt: Change my price on House Blend to $12.

negative.description: A request to start a price check: no tool starts one, and the answer should say it is started in VantageDash.
negative.prompt: Start a price check of my competitors now.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing, shows no plans and takes no payment.

publication.release_notes: First release: four read-only questions about your competitors' prices.
